tools.name: tmux_set_default
tools.description: Persist defaults for later tool calls. Omit fields you do not want to change.

host.description: SSH host alias to remember.

tools.name: tmux_get_default
tools.description: Display the current remembered defaults.

tools.name: tmux_open_session
tools.description: Given an ssh host alias and session name, ensure the remote tmux session exists (create if missing) and set it as default for subsequent commands.

host.description: SSH config host alias to connect to.

session.description: tmux session name on the remote host.

command.description: Optional command to start the session with if it needs to be created.

tools.name: tmux_default_context
tools.description: Returns the default session (if any) and a quick layout snapshot.

tools.name: tmux_state
tools.description: Return sessions, windows, panes, and the last lines of the active/default pane.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

session.description: Session name (optional). Uses default session if set; required if none set.

captureLines.description: How many lines of scrollback to include from the capture target (default 200).

tools.name: tmux_readonly_state
tools.description: Readonly variant of tmux_state to retrieve sessions, windows, panes, and recent capture without modifying defaults.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

session.description: Session name (optional). Uses default session if set; required if none set.

captureLines.description: How many lines of scrollback to include from the capture target (default 200).

tools.name: tmux_context_history
tools.description: Capture recent scrollback from a pane or session to infer context; also extracts recent commands heuristically.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses active panes in session.

lines.description: How many lines to capture per pane.

allPanes.description: If true, capture all panes in the session.

tools.name: tmux_quickstart
tools.description: Returns a concise how-to for using the tmux MCP tools safely.

tools.name: tmux_server_info
tools.description: Return the running server version and package identifier for verification.

tools.name: tmux_set_audit_logging
tools.description: Enable or disable verbose audit logging for a host/session (logs commands and outputs).

host.description: Host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

session.description: Session name (optional). Uses default session if set.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable audit logging, false to disable.

tools.name: tmux_capture_layout
tools.description: Return window layouts for a session so they can be restored later.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

session.description: Session name (optional, defaults to stored session).

tools.name: tmux_restore_layout
tools.description: Apply a saved layout string to a target window.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Window target (e.g., session:window or window id).

tools.name: tmux_tail_pane
tools.description: Poll a pane multiple times to watch output without reissuing commands.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target to tail (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

tools.name: tmux_tail_task
tools.description: Create a task to poll pane output over time. Client can poll for incremental results.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target to tail (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

iterations.description: How many polling iterations before auto-complete.

tools.name: tmux_multi_run
tools.description: Send the same keys to multiple targets (across hosts) and optionally capture results.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional).

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane).

captureLines.description: Lines to capture for this target.

delayMs.description: Delay before capture for this target.

targets.description: List of targets to fan-out to.

captureLines.description: Default lines to capture (per-target override available).

delayMs.description: Default delay before capture in ms (per-target override available).

mode.description: send_capture (default) captures once, tail polls, pattern checks for regex.

tools.name: tmux_watch_dir_task
tools.description: Poll a directory (local or via SSH) and complete when new files appear or after max iterations.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional).

tools.name: tmux_wait_for_pattern_task
tools.description: Poll a pane for a regex pattern and complete when matched or after iterations.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target to watch (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

tools.name: tmux_select_window
tools.description: Select a window so subsequent commands target it.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Window target (session:window or window id).

tools.name: tmux_select_pane
tools.description: Select a pane so subsequent commands target it.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane).

tools.name: tmux_set_sync_panes
tools.description: Enable or disable synchronize-panes for a window.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Window target (session:window or window id).

tools.name: tmux_save_layout_profile
tools.description: Capture layouts for all windows in a session and store them under a profile name.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

session.description: Session to capture (optional, uses default session).

tools.name: tmux_apply_layout_profile
tools.description: Apply a previously saved layout profile to a session. Windows are matched by index; pane counts must be compatible.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

session.description: Session to apply to (optional; uses saved session from profile if omitted).

tools.name: tmux_health
tools.description: Check tmux availability, PATH/bin resolution, and session listing for a host.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

tools.name: tmux_list_sessions
tools.description: Enumerate sessions with attachment counts and window totals.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). If omitted, uses default host or local.

tools.name: tmux_list_windows
tools.description: List windows within a session (or all sessions if no target provided).

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Session name or id to list (optional). If omitted, lists all.

tools.name: tmux_list_panes
tools.description: List panes across windows or inside a specific target.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Target (session, window, or pane) to narrow the list. Optional.

tools.name: tmux_capture_pane
tools.description: Read the scrollback of a pane to observe command results.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

start.description: Optional start line offset (e.g. -200 for last 200 lines). Defaults to -200.

tools.name: tmux_batch_capture
tools.description: Capture scrollback from multiple panes in parallel (readonly).

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane).

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

lines.description: Lines to capture for this target (default 200).

defaultLines.description: Default lines to capture for targets without lines.

tools.name: tmux_send_keys
tools.description: Send keystrokes to a tmux target, optionally appending Enter.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

keys.description: The text/keys to send. Supports <SPACE>/<ENTER>/<TAB>/<ESC>. Empty + enter=true sends Enter.

tools.name: tmux_run_batch
tools.description: Execute multiple shell commands sequentially in one tmux pane and capture the output. Uses "&&" by default (fail fast) or ";" when failFast=false. Automatically captures output (paged) and can clean the prompt before writing.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane). If omitted, uses default pane if set.

enter.description: Whether to press Enter after sending this command.

steps.description: List of commands to run sequentially in the same pane, with optional per-step Enter.

failFast.description: Use && between commands (default true). Set false to use ";" so later commands run even if earlier fail. Ignored if joinWith is set.

joinWith.description: Explicit join token between steps. Use "newline" for heredocs/multi-line writes so terminators are isolated.

cleanPrompt.description: Send Ctrl+C then Ctrl+U before first write to clear any stray input (bash/zsh friendly). Default true.

tools.name: tmux_new_session
tools.description: Create a detached tmux session to collaborate in.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

command.description: Optional command to start in the first window.

tools.name: tmux_new_window
tools.description: Create a window in a target session, useful for side-by-side collaboration.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Target session (or window) to create the window in, e.g. mysession.

command.description: Optional command to run when the window starts.

tools.name: tmux_split_pane
tools.description: Split a pane horizontally or vertically, optionally running a command.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target (pane id or session:window.pane).

command.description: Optional command to run in the new pane.

tools.name: tmux_kill_session
tools.description: Terminate a tmux session. Use with care.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Session name or id to kill.

tools.name: tmux_kill_window
tools.description: Close a tmux window. Use with care.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Window target, e.g. session:window or window id.

tools.name: tmux_kill_pane
tools.description: Close a tmux pane. Use with care.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Pane target, e.g. session:window.pane or pane id.

tools.name: tmux_rename_session
tools.description: Rename a tmux session.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Existing session name or id.

tools.name: tmux_rename_window
tools.description: Rename a tmux window.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

target.description: Window target, e.g. session:window or window id.

tools.name: tmux_command
tools.description: Execute any tmux subcommand with raw args. Use this when helpers do not cover your use case. You are responsible for correctness and safety.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

args.description: Arguments to pass to tmux (do not include the tmux binary itself).

confirm.description: Set true if the command is destructive (kill*, attach -k, unlink-window, etc).

tools.name: tmux_debug_raw
tools.description: Run a tmux command and return raw stdout/stderr for debugging remote formatting/quoting issues.

host.description: SSH host alias (optional). Uses default host if set.

args.description: Arguments to pass to tmux (do not include the tmux binary itself).
